name: CupertinoTabScaffold
description: An iOS-style scaffold that lays out the tab bar at the bottom and displays content for the selected tab. Commonly used for apps with multiple tabs.

properties.name: tabBar
properties.description: The tab bar displayed at the bottom of the scaffold.

properties.name: tabBuilder
properties.description: Builder function that returns the content widget for the selected tab index.
properties.possible_values: Any function that returns a Widget for a given tab index.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the scaffold.

properties.name: resizeToAvoidBottomInset
properties.description: Whether the scaffold should resize when the keyboard appears.

properties.name: controller
properties.description: Optional controller for managing the active tab programmatically.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.
